title: MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming
summary: Bitcoin Magazine MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming MARA sold about 40% of its bitcoin stack after Sept. 30, used $750 million to repay all its BTC-backed term loans and said it will keep selling to fund AI infrastructure, convertible note puts and buybacks. This post MARA Sells 13,597 Bitcoin for $1.1 Billion, Says More Sales Are Coming first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
